28:18.text: And Jesus came and said to them, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
28:18.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

28:19.text: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
28:19.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

28:20.text: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, to the close of the age."
